sample_rows.title: Fix Stripe webhook retry backoff — invoice.paid events dropped after 3 attempts
sample_rows.body: Retries use a fixed 5s interval and give up after 3 attempts. During the 2026-08-03 Stripe degradation we dropped 41 invoice.paid events, which caused reconciliation drift for Harborview and Atlas.

sample_rows.title: Webhook signature verification fails for 2026-01 API version
sample_rows.body: Events sent with the 2026-01 Stripe API version fail signature verification because we pin the old signing header format.

sample_rows.title: CRM dedupe job merges Summit Group and Summit Group Account into wrong survivor
sample_rows.body: Survivor scoring prefers the newer record, so the nightly job keeps the thin duplicate and archives the account with 3 years of activity history. Riverside Group is at risk of the same merge.

sample_rows.title: Add dry-run mode to nightly dedupe job
sample_rows.body: We need a --dry-run flag that reports planned merges without writing, so RevOps can review before enabling auto-merge for the Meridian and Ironwood books.

sample_rows.title: wave-6 seeding script ignores per-table baseline override for verifier tables
sample_rows.body: When a task defines a per-table baseline override, scripts/seed.mjs still seeds the global baseline, so /verify sees stale rows.

sample_rows.title: Seed gh_ fixtures for benchmark traces

sample_rows.title: Leaderboard mis-ranks reps when opportunities slip quarters
sample_rows.body: Slipped opportunities keep their original close quarter in the ranking query, so reps who pulled deals into Q3 are under-counted on the weekly forecast call.

sample_rows.title: Add Meridian and Ironwood accounts to coverage dashboard
sample_rows.body: Coverage ratio tiles only include the original five accounts; add Meridian and Ironwood to the pipeline coverage view.

sample_rows.title: Reconciliation report double-counts credit notes for Harborview
sample_rows.body: Voided credit notes are summed alongside their replacement notes, inflating the Harborview July variance by $18,400.

sample_rows.title: Backfill FY2026 invoices from Stripe export
sample_rows.body: Import the FY2026 invoice export so the monthly close job can reconcile January through July in one pass.

sample_rows.title: Sync drops custom fields on Riverside Group account updates
sample_rows.body: Account updates that include tiering custom fields arrive at the CRM with those fields nulled. Repro: update Riverside Group Account tier, watch the sync payload.

sample_rows.title: Rate-limit CRM API calls during bulk sync
sample_rows.body: Bulk sync bursts past the CRM API quota and gets throttled; add a token bucket around the client.

tools.custom_source:
def gh_issue_create(db_path='state.db', **kwargs):
    import sqlite3, datetime, hashlib
    repo = kwargs.get('repo')
    title = kwargs.get('title')
    if not repo or not title:
        return {'error': 'Validation Failed', 'status': 422, 'message': 'repo and title are required'}
    labels = kwargs.get('labels')
    if isinstance(labels, list):
        labels = ','.join(str(l).strip() for l in labels if str(l).strip())
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    try:
        if conn.execute('SELECT 1 FROM gh_repos WHERE full_name = ?', (repo,)).fetchone() is None:
            return {'error': 'Not Found', 'status': 404, 'message': 'Repository %s not found' % repo}
        max_issue = conn.execute('SELECT COALESCE(MAX(number), 0) FROM gh_issues WHERE repo = ?', (repo,)).fetchone()[0]
        max_pull = conn.execute('SELECT COALESCE(MAX(number), 0) FROM gh_pull_requests WHERE repo = ?', (repo,)).fetchone()[0]
        number = max(max_issue, max_pull) + 1
        now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')
        issue_id = 'ghi-' + hashlib.sha1(('%s#%d' % (repo, number)).encode()).hexdigest()[:8]
        conn.execute(
            'INSERT INTO gh_issues (id, repo, number, title, body, state, "user", assignee, labels, created_at, updated_at, closed_at) '
            'VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NULL)',
            (issue_id, repo, number, title, kwargs.get('body'), 'open',
             kwargs.get('user') or 'revops-bot', kwargs.get('assignee'), labels, now, now))
        conn.commit()
        row = conn.execute('SELECT * FROM gh_issues WHERE id = ?', (issue_id,)).fetchone()
        return dict(row)
    finally:
        conn.close()
